## What Prajyot Infotech Does

Prajyot Infotech is a professional software development and business digitalization company based in India. The company helps small and medium businesses across India and globally to go digital by building custom software, websites, mobile apps, and automation systems.

## Services Offered

1. Professional Business Websites — Custom-designed, fast, mobile-friendly websites for businesses of all sizes.
2. E-Commerce Websites — Full online stores with product catalogs, cart, checkout, and payment integration.
3. Android & iOS Mobile Apps — Native and cross-platform mobile applications for business operations and customer engagement.
4. Custom Software Development — Bespoke software solutions tailored to specific business workflows and requirements.
5. Business Management Systems — Integrated systems to manage operations, orders, inventory, staff, and reporting in one platform.
6. CRM & Admin Dashboard Solutions — Customer relationship management tools and admin dashboards for sales and client tracking.
7. Inventory Management Systems — Real-time inventory tracking software for retailers, wholesalers, and manufacturers.
8. Billing & ERP Systems — Billing software, invoicing tools, and enterprise resource planning systems for efficient business operations.
9. UI/UX Design & Branding Solutions — Modern interface design, brand identity, and digital design systems.
10. WhatsApp & Business Automation — WhatsApp Business API integration, automated messaging, and business process automation.
11. Domain, Hosting & Technical Support — Complete technical setup including domain registration, hosting, and ongoing support.
12. Custom Digitalization Solutions — Tailored digital transformation services for businesses moving from manual to digital operations.
